newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle not well established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested on a live basis, compared to Friday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow, with demand and seller interest light. Offerings were moderate. Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1225-1300 lbs few 67.00 Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared to Friday's close - Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested.
